title: Gunshot
blurb: One clean crack with the reverb trimmed off — the standard-issue bang for action edits, western standoffs and the start of a race. Editors reach for this constantly because it does something no other sound does: it hard-cuts a scene. Everything before it is one thing, everything after is another, and no explanation is required. Use it for dramatic exits, startle cuts, and the audio equivalent of a full stop landing mid-sentence. Sharp, professional, no echo baggage attached. Handle it with the same care you would apply to any full stop.
origin: A clean single gunshot for edits and dramatic punctuation.
